searches.reason: Build a calibrated diagnostic suite that distinguishes masked-token recovery, training-exposed prefix recovery and held-out next-item ranking. Investigate candidate-sampling sensitivity, user-bootstrap uncertainty and fault-injection tests for target leakage, incorrect left-padding readout and missing appended masks. Keep the host evaluator fixed; use training-prefix experiments for probe development and validation HR@10 only for model selection.

searches.reason: Translate qualitative complaints into auditable failure labels: redundant function, explicit specification conflict, unsupported ownership assumption, stale intent and insufficient relevance evidence. Seek methods using only histories, timestamps, titles, descriptions and observed feedback, with abstention when evidence is missing. Validate annotation agreement and precision before reporting prevalence; five users per category cannot establish population rates or latent preferences.
searches.query: recommendation diagnostics actionable user feedback taxonomy purchase intent redundancy compatibility evidence grounded annotation selective prediction uncertainty 2024 2025 2026

searches.reason: Develop controlled history interventions that connect failures to one BERT4Rec network's temporal and contextual processing. Compare recent versus older history deletion against length-matched random deletion, matched replacement and position controls, freezing candidate sets. Seek sanity checks for attribution reliability and ways to connect measured effects to masking objectives or positional representations without treating perturbations as causal evidence of user preferences.
